"Yes, that's it!" Pond cries, "They said they'd do terrible things if I didn't cooperate! Torture, murder, terrible things. Pathers will do anything!"

"Pather heretics," Bornanew says, his voice icy. "You do know, Ulmus Pond, how we Knights deal with Pather heretics?" Bornanew stands and reaches into his satchel.

Pond goes paler, somehow. "N-no, no. I'll confess! I'll do penance, I'll pray! I'll tell you whatever you want. Tell him!" He looks to you.

"There was... a Walker of the Path," Pond sputters. "The Luddic Path."

"He told me to talk to Menes, to, to make the offer. He said a Mammonite couldn't resist an object of such unique quality. And- and I was to arrange transport from the Fringe. Make it appear legitimate. Set the documents straight."

Bornanew draws his cheap datapad from his satchel, the screen already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.

Bornanew gives you a warning look. Pond simply deflates, looking utterly lost. "There was... a Walker," he sputters. "Of the Luddic Path."

"He told me to talk to Menes, to, to make the offer. He said a Mammonite couldn't resist an object of such unique quality. And- and I was to arrange transport from the Fringe. Make it appear legitimate. Set the documents straight."

Bornanew draws his cheap datapad from his satchel, the screen already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.

Bornanew sighs deeply, dropping his previous countenance, and looks at you with almost a sadness in his eyes. "This is not as we agreed. I ask now that you stand aside and allow me to complete this unsavory task."

With that, his face goes blank and he turns, seizing Pond by the neck with one hand and lifting him off the cot with a choked sound.
"What, it seems, I must," he says flatly.

"Ulmus," he growls and, with his other hand Bornanew lifts his cheap datapad to within reach of Pond's flailing arms. The screen is already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.

"Show us where the glove came from. Then you may breathe."

Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew concedes by lowering him back onto the cot.

Gasping and choking, Pond marks a system. It is difficult to make out his words. Something about "pather".

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ulmus' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. Then he looks up and his eyes go wide.

"Sedge!" he rasps.

Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew concedes by lowering him back onto the cot.

Gasping and choking, Pond marks a system. It is difficult to make out his words. Something about "pather".

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ponds' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. "Sedge," he rasps, finally.

Bornanew shoots a look at you.

Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew holds the pad steady for him.

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. The threat retreats from his voice. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ulmus' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. Then he looks up and his eyes go wide.

"Sedge!"

Wrestling Sedge shows you his broken smile.

"Captain $playerFirstName, again. And again the man with too much faith, Bornanew. Jethro Bornanew. See?"

Sedge's pistol is unwavering.

"This time I remember for you."

Wrestling Sedge shows you his broken smile.

"Captain $playerFirstName! It is good to see you. And again the man with too much faith, Bornanew. Jethro Bornanew. See?"

Sedge's pistol is unwavering.

"This time I remember for you. But," he frowns, "unlucky for me to find you on this path."

You and Sedge exchange a look as muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window. He makes a dissatisfied grunt.
Sedge makes a dissatisfied grunt. Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.

Sedge makes a grunt which sounds like agreement. Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.

As your hand moves toward your belt, Sedge's pistol twitches at your center of mass. He meets your eyes, his gleaming with fearless intensity, and gives a tiny shake of his head. Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.

"Because I must do this." Sedge's pistol twitches toward your center of mass. "It is the Path."

Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.
"The Path cannot bend. Not now," he says gruffly. His gun twitches at Ulmus Pond and makes a grinding shriek like a tool dropped into a rotary engine.
Ulmus' blood splatters across the window panel, turning the room a muddy red. In that moment, Bornanew launches himself at Sedge.

The pistol grinds again, catching Bornanew mid-leap.

His massive body, twitching and bleeding, crashes into Sedge's legs, setting the Pather off-balance.

In one smooth motion you draw your sidearm and place a shot in Sedge's head.

With a sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his eyes blank, his expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.

In one smooth motion you draw a grenade, sliding a finger along just-so to set yield to minimum, and gently toss it toward Sedge's head. You see the beginning of a confused start on his face before the flash, and a loud clap uncomfortable almost to the point of pain.

Sedge slides back against the wall, his face caught in the eternal surprise of death. Blood begins to trickle from his nose, his eyes, his ears, his mouth. The skin of his face blooms red. It will look like a bloated purple mass in only minutes.

In one smooth motion you draw and activate your ceramic vibroknife, sweeping it in an arc which intersects Sedge's throat. There is no resistance.

With a wet sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his face down, his eyes staring blankly up at you, his expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.

In one smooth motion you raise your hand and activate the poison spray, angling upward and away from the bleeding body of Bornanew. A misting of the air disappears in a blink as if it were never there.

With a wet cough and a whining, choking sound, Sedge's body slides back against the wall. His eyes blink once at you, expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.

In one smooth motion you draw the false fingertip of the monomolecular wire and throw it in an arc which intersects Sedge's neck. There is no resistance.

With a wet sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his head askew. His eyes blink once at you, expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.

In one smooth motion you draw your sword and sweep it in an arc intersecting Sedge's throat.

With a wet sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his face down, his eyes staring blankly up at you, his expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.

In a motion born of long hours of training, your leg snaps toward Sedge at the speed of thought. It meets the center of his head with full force, cracking his head back in a violent jerk.

A single shudder passes through his body, from his thick neck, already purpling from devastated bone and tissue, to his booted feet. His head slumps to the side at an unnatural angle, blood running from what remains of his nose, and his mouth and eyes.

Bornanew lives, by a thread.

In the moments since the exchange, a time hollowed out by violence and filled with the fleeting intensity of adrenaline, your security team appears.

Finding you unhurt, they attach stabilization packs and trauma strips to the fallen Knight. He's left an incredible pool of blood in the cheap apartment. It drips down the narrow stairs.

The other two bodies lie dead.

It is unclear how fully Ulmus Pond was exploited by or truly believed in the Pather cause, but his loyalty - if he ever had any - died with him.

You carry Bornanew's leather satchel to the shuttle. Your team carries his unconscious body. 

As it lifts, he is laid across several seats. The designated medic keeps close watch over the small ad-hoc network of medical machines.

Bornanew's datapad opens to your touch, allowing you to access the coordinates given by Ulmus Pond. And a recording of the brief interrogation. $global.jethroName planned for the possibility of his incapacitation, or death. And gave you access to his work.

A medical team rushes past you, to Bornanew, as you step out onto your flagship. 

He'll live, you are assured. But it'll hurt; this is left unsaid by your flagship's chief medical officer.

It is quite clear to you now that this is a Pather conspiracy, and they will kill to keep it from unravelling. Your next step is to the source of the fake relic: a lonely orbit on the fringe of the Persean Sector.

In the $bffi_patherStationSystem.

Tears stream down Ponds' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. "Sedge," he says.

Bornanew shoots a look at you.

"This was before," Pond says. "His people are still... they're everywhere. They'll kill me."

He looks at you hopefully. "You've got to help me."

"This was before," Pond says. "His people are still... they're everywhere. They'll kill me."

He looks at Bornanew hopefully. "You said you'd keep me safe. As a Knight."

$global.jethroName closes his eyes and sighs.

"This," Pond coughs violently, holding his throat, "-before. Pathers... everywhere. Kill me."

He looks at you fearfully after a glance at Bornanew. "... help me."

Bornanew looks at you, then to Pond. Then speaks.

"I shall bring you to an agent of the Knights of Ludd. You shall confess all your sins, beginning first with that of heresy. They shall assign your penance."
